headline: MB surpasses 10,000 billion dong in budget payments for the first time, reinforcing its position as a leading Vietnamese bank
summary: MB paid more than 10,000 billion dong in budget contributions for the first time, according to a ceremony honoring top taxpayers in Vietnam for 2026. The event was held on September 15.
why: MB, formally Military Commercial Joint Stock Bank, is one of Vietnam's large listed lenders, and its tax payments reflect its scale in the domestic banking sector.
